died.name: Marcus Aurelius
died.last_words: Go to the rising sun, for I am setting. Think more of death than of me.

died.name: Juraj Jánošík
died.desc: Slovak highwayman known as "the Slovak Robin Hood"
died.cause: refusing to name fellow robbers prior to jumping onto the hook on which he was to be hung
died.last_words: If you have baked me so you also should eat me!

died.name: Lawrence Oates
died.desc: British army officer and Antarctic explorer
died.cause: prior to walking out of tent and into blizzard on Terra Nova Expedition
died.last_words: I am just going outside and may be some time.

died.name: Eddie Aikau
died.cause: leaving voyaging canoe Hōkūleʻa after it began leaking to paddle to shore for help. The rest of the canoe's crew were rescued
died.last_words: Don't worry, I can do it. I can get to land.
